name: Full Audit & Dual Test Runner Pipeline

nodes.name: Spec & Contract Alignment Audit
nodes.prompt_template: Verify 1:1 key alignment between design specs, Pydantic schemas, and API contracts.

verification_gate.verifier_prompt: Run test_contracts.py to verify key alignment.

nodes.name: Dual Test Runner (pytest + behave)
nodes.prompt_template: Execute pytest unit test suite AND behave Gherkin feature scenarios.

verification_gate.verifier_prompt: Verify both pytest and behave suites report 100% pass rate.

nodes.name: Evidence Ledger Verification
nodes.prompt_template: Execute validate_evidence.py to programmatically confirm all Evidence IDs in EVIDENCE.md match files on disk.
